meta.description: Quick-command shortcuts for the MathsLMS multi-agent pipeline on Hermes AgentOS

commands.description: Generates all content for a specified unit: concept scripts → formatted JSON → Manim animations → problem sets. Runs the full pipeline: Curriculum -> Content -> Animation -> Problems. Each stage validates before the next begins.

stages.action: Write concept scripts covering every topic in the unit. Produces JSON files with hook, explanation, worked examples.
Format all concept scripts into structured JSON with validated LaTeX. Adds metadata, content hash, version tracking.
Write Manim Python scripts for each concept. Produces 1-4 scenes per topic covering key visual moments.
Generate 16 practice problems per topic (4 per difficulty level: Foundation, Core, Challenge, Extension) with full solutions.

commands.notes: Pipeline runs sequentially. Orchestrator validates each stage before dispatching the next. The track (igcse_o|a_level|imo) is inferred from the unit prefix or the current project phase.

commands.description: Queues GIF renders for all Manim scripts in a unit. The Deploy agent runs Manim CE render commands and uploads resulting GIFs. Updates gif_renders table with status.

stages.action: Verify that all Manim .py scripts exist for the unit. Report any missing scripts.
Queue all Manim scripts for rendering. Run: manim -pql {script.py} for preview quality, or -pqh for high quality. Capture stdout/stderr for each render.
Update gif_renders table entries: set render_status to 'done' or 'error', record file_size_kb, duration_sec, and final gif_path.

commands.notes: Renders run on the VPS GPU (if available) or CPU (software render). Preview quality (-pql) is recommended for initial renders. Full quality (-pqh) for final production. GIF render time varies from 30s to 5min per script depending on complexity.

commands.description: Runs full quality assurance on all content for a unit. The QA agent reviews curriculum JSONs, Manim scripts, problem sets, and walkthroughs. Produces a structured QA report with ERROR/WARNING/INFO findings.

stages.action: Collect all artifacts for the unit: curriculum content JSONs, animation scripts, problem sets, and walkthroughs (if any).

Review each artifact: verify mathematical accuracy (recalculate all working), LaTeX validity, pedagogical quality, and format compliance. Cross-reference problems with solutions and worked examples with answers.
Produce a QA report. Classify each finding as ERROR (must fix), WARNING (should fix), or INFO (optional). Include corrected versions for all errors.
Review QA verdict. If PASS: promote unit to 'Live' status. If FLAGGED: route errors back to originating agents with the QA report for fixes.

commands.notes: QA is the gate before promotion to Live. Units with ERROR findings will not be promoted. The QA agent uses the same model as the content producers for accuracy checking. Run /qa-unit after all other pipeline stages are complete.

commands.description: Returns the current state of the MathsLMS content pipeline. Queries the content_tasks, gif_renders, and past_paper_progress tables to build a summary of all work items: pending, in_progress, done, and flagged. Also reports pipeline_stats metrics.

stages.action: Query mathlms.db: SELECT track, unit, stage, status, COUNT(*) FROM content_tasks GROUP BY track, unit, stage, status. Build a structured summary grouped by track and unit.
Query mathlms.db: SELECT render_status, COUNT(*) FROM gif_renders GROUP BY render_status. Report GIF queue status (queued/rendering/done/error).
Query mathlms.db: SELECT collection, SUM(tagged)/SUM(total_questions) as pct FROM past_paper_progress GROUP BY collection. Report past paper tagging progress.
Query mathlms.db: SELECT metric, value FROM pipeline_stats ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 20. Report key metrics.

commands.notes: This is a read-only query command. It does not modify any state. Returns a formatted multi-section summary suitable for display in Telegram or the dashboard.

commands.description: Shows available MathsLMS pipeline commands, their syntax, and descriptions. Lists all quick-commands with brief usage notes.

stages.action: Return the list of registered quick-commands with their syntax and one-line descriptions. Include the overall pipeline flow diagram.

commands.notes: Displays: /generate-unit, /render-gifs, /qa-unit, /pipeline-status, and /mathos-help itself. Also shows the pipeline phase sequence: Backlog -> Scripting -> Animating -> QA Review -> Live.
